notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
You have a green nonartifact permanent card in hand with mana cost {G}.
You control a nontoken nonartifact green permanent with mana cost {G} that shares a card type with the card in hand.
description:
Cast the green permanent card in your hand by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Vigor and Aetherflux Reservoir triggers.
Resolve the Defiler of Vigor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
The green permanent enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning another nontoken nonartifact green permanent with mana cost {G} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinite times to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
